CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS archived_files (
  file_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  filename TEXT,
  date TEXT,
  owner TEXT,
  flags TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  archived_at TEXT,
  original_table TEXT
);
INSERT INTO archived_files (file_id, filename, date, owner, flags, notes, archived_at, original_table)
SELECT file_id, filename, date, owner, flags, notes, DATE('now') AS archived_at, 'file_inventory' AS original_table
FROM file_inventory
WHERE date < '2020-01-01';
DELETE FROM file_inventory WHERE date < '2020-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM file_inventory WHERE date < '2020-01-01';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_archived_files_archived_at ON archived_files(archived_at);
